title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a step in workflows
summary: The new Code node lets makers run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors can't handle. Data transforms, calculations, regex, and advanced parsing. File conversion and parsing (for example PDF → text, CSV, XML). Generate the code from natural language with AI, or write and edit it by hand. GA date: November CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
summary: The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs. Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents. Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps. Pass files to connectors to email, save to SharePoint/OneDrive, or attach to records. GA date: November CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
summary: Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it. Share from the workflows page or the designer. Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing. See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share. Co-owners can edit and run the workflow. GA date: December CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
summary: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account. GA date: December CY2026

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
summary: Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center. Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn , providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. title: Discover and review Power Pages sites with Power Platform inventory (public preview)
summary: Support for Power Pages sites in Power Platform inventory is now in public preview. Administrators can now discover and review sites across environments in one place, alongside apps, flows, and agents.
